args.message: Among 'ok' orders, North has the largest share of revenue at about 33.2%, followed by South at 31.6%, East at 20.2% and West at 14.6%. Orders whose customer has no known region make up about 0.4% and appear as the null row. Each share is a region's total order amount divided by the company's total for all 'ok' orders.
